title: A Space Explosion 70 Times Brighter Than Any Ever Seen

scenes.text: In 2022, a space explosion was 70 times brighter than any ever recorded.
It was called the BOAT, short for brightest of all time.
Its light had traveled for about 1.9 billion years before it reached us.
Telescopes in space and on the ground caught it. Even Voyager 1 detected it.
Astronomers estimate a burst this bright happens only once in 10,000 years.
We just happened to be watching. Brightest of all time.

description:
On October 9, 2022, a gamma ray burst called GRB 221009A hit Earth, 70 times brighter than any ever seen.
Its light traveled about 1.9 billion years. NASA scientists estimate an event this bright happens only about once in 10,000 years.
What do you think caused it? Comment below.
first_comment: The last burst this bright may have been 10,000 years ago, before writing existed. What do you think we missed?
